title: Listing - internal QA slate: telemetry & fallback matrix (worknote)
content:
Purpose:
Quick working doc to capture the internal QA checklist we run before publishing a cloud listing (tile + trial), the telemetry we need to capture to measure health, and a simple fallback matrix for listing-side failures. Intended for GTM, Solutions, and Eng to iterate on during listing sprints. Not customer-facing yet.

Context / motivation:
We keep getting late-stage QA asks (billing mismatch, trial provisioning timing, tile copy mismatch) that cost last-minute engineering cycles. This slate centralizes the acceptance criteria and the telemetry events we need instrumented so prod incidents during listing launch are reduced. Also sketches the fallback behavior when marketplace APIs or SKU provisioning fail.

High-level acceptance criteria (must pass all):
- Tile copy displayed in cloud marketplace UI matches approved hero + bullets (exact character counts sanity check on tile preview).
- Trial SKU provisioned within targeted SLA (15–60s for API return; 5 min for backend worker fallback).
- Billing entitlement created and mapped correctly to Redwood SKU mapping table.
- Customer onboarding flow (first 3 screens) completes without auth redirect loops for at least 95% of test accounts.
- Telemetry for events below are emitted and visible in the GTM dashboard before go-live.
- Rollback plan validated in staging (toggle to hide tile and revoke trial provisioning).

Quick copy variants to sanity-check on tile preview (short title / short blurb / one-line CTA):
- Title (20 char target): Redwood Inference — Predictable LLM Serving
- Short blurb (60 char target): High-throughput LLM inference with SLA-backed capacity
- CTA: Start free trial / Try in Azure / Request demo (test which CTA performs better in tile impressions)

Telemetry: required events and attributes (key names we expect from Eng):
- marketplace.tile.rendered {listing_id, region, user_bucket}
- marketplace.tile.clicked {listing_id, user_id, referrer}
- marketplace.trial.requested {account_id, sku, partner_tx_id}
- marketplace.trial.provisioned {account_id, sku, success_bool, duration_ms, backend_variant}
- marketplace.trial.failed {account_id, sku, reason_code, retry_allowed}
- marketplace.billing.mapped {internal_sku, partner_sku, mapping_version}
- marketplace.usage.first_call {account_id, model_family, latency_ms}
- marketplace.rollback.triggered {listing_id, reason, initiated_by}
Notes on attributes: include hardware_region, latency bucket, and backend_variant (dedicated/deduped/cached path) so we can correlate performance regressions with serving runtime config.

Observability checks (pre-launch):
- dashboard: tile impressions -> clicks -> trial requests -> successful provisioning pipeline (funnel) visible for the sandbox tenant.
- alert: >5% trial provisioning failure over 1h OR mean provisioning duration > 3x expected. Priority to set to P2.
- synthetic monitor: provision 10 trials every 10 minutes from multiple regions, assert success within SLA.

Fallback matrix (when things go wrong):
1) Marketplace API rate limit (429) or partial error:
  - Behavior: queue provisioning request in retry queue with exponential backoff (max 6 retries spanning ~5 minutes).
  - UI: show ephemeral 'Provisioning' state with progress indicator and link to status page.
  - Telemetry: emit marketplace.trial.requeued with retry_count.
2) Billing mapping lookup missing/mismatch:
  - Behavior: hold provisioning and surface manual review flag in internal ops console; allow customer-visible grace period (limited features) until mapping resolved.
  - UI: CTA becomes 'Contact sales — billing verification required'.
  - Telemetry: marketplace.billing.issue with mapping_hint and ticket_id.
3) Backend worker fails to allocate capacity (OOM, quota):
  - Behavior: try lower-tier compatible model variant automatically (quantized / smaller model) and mark provisioning with backend_variant=degraded.
  - UI: show degraded performance note and ETA for full capacity.
  - Telemetry: marketplace.trial.provisioned success_bool=false initially, then if fallback runs success_bool=true with backend_variant set.
4) Persistent unknown error (>5m):
  - Behavior: cancel provisioning and issue refund/credit via billing pipeline; escalate to on-call SRE and notify partner manager.
  - Telemetry: marketplace.trial.failed reason_code=escalate_manual.

QA runbook (staging -> preprod -> prod):
- Step 0: unlock sandbox listing and run tile-preview check (copy lengths, icons, screenshots) — GTM owns approval.
- Step 1: mapping test: create mapping row in mapping table and run end-to-end provisioning for 5 synthetic accounts across 3 regions.
- Step 2: failure-mode tests: simulate 429 from marketplace API, simulate billing mapping absent, simulate worker OOM. Verify fallback matrix behaviors and telemetry emission.
- Step 3: gating approval: product + legal sign-off (check data residency and egress language on tile).
- Step 4: staged rollout: 10% of impressions for 24h, monitor funnel and errors; if metrics good expand 50% then 100%.

Experiment ideas (A/B tests to run post-launch):
- CTA variant test: 'Start free trial' vs 'Try in Azure' vs 'Contact sales' — measure trial-rate per click and downstream activation.
- Tile blurb length test: short vs long (60 vs 120 char) — measure CTR and confusion rate on support tickets.
- Fallback messaging test: transparent degraded message vs silent fallback — measure support volume and retention.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Legal: confirm the phrasing around data usage for trial logs when provisioning via marketplace. (Ping @Legal: CONFLUENCE-TR-221)
- SRE: need an endpoint for synthetic provisioning that returns structured reasons on failure (JIRA: SRE-504).
- Billing: final mapping table schema and the canonical internal_sku -> partner_sku contract (owner: Evan).
- UX: need a short set of screenshots for tile preview (desktop + mobile).

Slack threads and PRs to reference while iterating:
- #marketplace-launch (thread: 2025-02-11 provisioning flakiness)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-assets/pull/214 (tile images + icons)

Owner / next steps:
- Priya Menon: consolidate this doc into the final QA checklist and send to product/legal by 2025-03-07.
- Evan Brooks: confirm billing mapping contract by 2025-03-05.
- Maya Patel: wireframe the tile previews and A/B variants by 2025-03-04.

Footer: this is intentionally a working note. Add comments inline in Drive or push edits directly; we will convert to the formal preflight checklist once the mapping and telemetry contracts are finalized.
